<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This script is a legitimate helper utility for the `linux-xanmod-headers` AUR package. It allows users to select a CPU microarchitecture for GCC kernel compilation optimization. The script performs standard operations: it detects the host CPU via `gcc`, presents a menu of known x86 microarchitectures, and modifies the kernel `.config` file to set appropriate `CONFIG_*` options (e.g., `CONFIG_MZEN`, `CONFIG_MSKYLAKE`). No network requests are made, no data is exfiltrated, no external code is downloaded or executed, and no obfuscated commands are present. The `sed` operations target only the kernel build configuration file `.config`, which is expected behavior for a kernel package. The use of `/usr/share/makepkg/util/message.sh` is standard for Arch Linux packages. This script conforms to ordinary packaging practices and shows no signs of supply-chain injection.
</details>
